SAE Question: How long did it take to build the Lincoln Memorial?
AAVE Question: How long it take to build da Lincoln Memorial?
SPARQL:
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT
  ?memorial
  ?memorialLabel
  (MIN(?start0) AS ?constructionStart)
  (COALESCE(MAX(?end0), MAX(?opening0), MAX(?inception0)) AS ?constructionEnd)
  ((COALESCE(MAX(?end0), MAX(?opening0), MAX(?inception0)) - MIN(?start0)) AS ?buildDuration)
WHERE {
  ?memorial rdfs:label "Lincoln Memorial"@en.

  OPTIONAL {
    ?memorial p:P793 ?statement.
    ?statement ps:P793 wd:Q385378.   # construction
    OPTIONAL { ?statement pq:P580 ?start0. }  # start time
    OPTIONAL { ?statement pq:P582 ?end0. }    # end time
  }

  OPTIONAL { ?memorial wdt:P1619 ?opening0. }   # official opening
  OPTIONAL { ?memorial wdt:P571  ?inception0. } # inception/completion

  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}
GROUP BY ?memorial ?memorialLabel
LIMIT 1
Name: ['Lincoln Memorial']
